summary: Diff implements a more robust frontend-only background music system: a persistent HTMLAudioElement with autoplay-block recovery via document-level gesture listeners, additional readiness/error handling, and a UI prompt/button (“Tap to enable sound”) when playback is blocked. Some REQ-15 acceptance details (looping across stage transitions without restarting; immediate pause on toggle off; toggle-on behavior) cannot be fully verified due to truncation of useBackgroundMusic.ts.

missing_requirements.requirement: Playback continues looping across stage transitions (question -> celebration) without restarting unexpectedly; music OFF pauses immediately; toggling ON triggers a play attempt and, if blocked, waits for next user gesture.
missing_requirements.reason: The hook file containing playback control, cleanup, and toggle/pause logic is truncated, so it is not possible to confirm looping continuity across stage transitions, immediate pause on disable, or the exact toggle-on/off behaviors from the provided diff summary alone.

missing_requirements.requirement: The music control UI communicates a clear English status when audio is unavailable (e.g., "Audio failed to load") and the toggle does not misleadingly imply that music is playing.
missing_requirements.reason: Header.tsx displays a tooltip with `audioStatus`, but the derivation/content of `statusText` (the English status string) is not shown because useBackgroundMusic.ts is truncated. Therefore, it cannot be confirmed that a clear English failure status is actually produced and surfaced.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a YouTube URL reference comment in the background music hook.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly constrains not to stream audio from YouTube; while this is only a comment (not streaming), referencing YouTube is not requested by the spec and may be misleading.
